### Vision

efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our

[ Who we are ][82]

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

ALVION PHARMACEUTICALS

# A science oriented pharmaceutical company

Developing and manufacturing noninfringing generic medicines in Europe.

# About us

Alvion is a science oriented pharmaceutical company developing and manufacturing non infringing
generic medicines in Europe. Collaborating with state of the art R&D centers in EU, Alvion is a
private and independent company focusing in R&D, IP, Quality, Regulatory and manufacturing of
generic and added value medicines, delivering an exceptional track record in the global
pharmaceutical market supplying millions of patients.

[Read more .][12]

# Why Alvion?

Developing, manufacturing, and promoting medicines in Europe, MENA, Canada, Australia, South Africa,
Australia, Asia and Latin America is the core business model of Alvion. **Focusing on delivering
innovation and best quality pharmaceuticals among the first companies prior the patent expiry while
offering flexible terms** and affordable medicines with an effective supply chain is major
competitive advantage of Alvion.

[Read more .][13]

[vision-card-icons]

## Our Vision

Alvion is a science pharmaceutical company offering difficult to develop and non-infringing products
to its partners, setting a new standard in generics by combining our experiences with an
understanding of the health care needs in a global level.

[flag-card-icons]

## Our Mission

Having diversified business model that enriches quality of life and delivers outstanding value to
all stakeholders.
[target-card-icons]

## Our Goal

is to become a leading and vertically integrated pharmaceutical company, establishing a global
presence, serving the healthcare communities and satisfying high performance employees.

Why collaborate with us:

# our partners’ success is our success

By raising the barrier of customer service and innovation, Alvion’s team is developing and producing
blockbuster molecules, registering the products across a wide territory. Alvion is offering a
complete and competitive “package” to its partners delivering end to end products and services at
all stages of the partnership.

[Read more .][14]

[alvion-collaborate]

# Partner with Alvion

Contact Business Development Department at [bd@alvionpharma.com][15]

# Innovation with a Global Presence

At Alvion, **we are rethinking pharmaceuticals with a new business model that creates the
pharmaceutical company of tomorrow.** We strive for a change that is clearly visible in the various
pharmaceutical markets, our model, processes and actions.

[Read more .][16]

[alvion-research]

# Research and Development

Developing in third parties’ high technology and non-infringing Intellectual Properties, often
patented technologies, Alvion is an IP powerhouse providing licensing rights to the largest
pharmaceutical companies in the world.

[Read more .][17]

# Products

Our people are a core aspect of Alvion’ s competitive advantage. We attract and retain key talents
with a high level of expertise and know-how who drive our business forward.

[Read more .][18]

# Innovations equals successful business

Alvion is welcoming business opportunities with multinational and strong local pharmaceutical
companies partnering with Alvion’s products via licensing agreements, both in the proprietary and
the supply.

[Read more .][19]

[avion-innovations]

# Our Sustainability Commitment

Alvion Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to creating a healthier future through responsible and
sustainable practices. Guided by **ESG principles**, we focus on reducing our environmental
footprint, continuously supporting our people and ensuring transparent and ethical corporate
governance.

[Read more .][20]

# Career

We are looking for talents. Should you wish to work with one of the most dynamic teams in the
industry, please share your CV with us at [career@alvionpharma.com ][21]

# Code of conduct

Alvion is committed to fair and vigorous competition because this is essential to ensure appropriate
and fair market and even more so to ensure full access to affordable healthcare. Alvion does not
tolerate any breach or possible infringement of any competition laws and regulations in any of its
businesses.

[Read more .][22]

## APECS – European pilot line for advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration

APECS (Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration for Electronic Components and Systems) is a
European pilot line established under the EU Chips Act. It provides industry, SMEs and research
organizations with access to technologies, infrastructure and expertise for chiplet innovation,
system integration and industrial deployment. By connecting development, testing and pilot-scale
manufacturing, APECS accelerates the transition from research to application and strengthens
Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem.

### Get in touch with our experts!

Don’t hesitate to contact us.

We look forward to your inquiry and will respond shortly.

[Direct contact][24]

## Explore APECS capabilities, infrastructure and pathways

© Adobe Stock

### What APECS offers


Access technologies, infrastructure and services for advanced packaging, chiplets and system
integration.


[Explore offerings][25]

© Fraunhofer IPMS / Oliver Killig

### How APECS works

 

A distributed European pilot line connecting design, manufacturing and testing into one continuous
workflow.

[Explore infrastructure][26]

© FBH/Matthias Baumbach

### Who APECS is for

 

For industry, SMEs and research developing and scaling semiconductor technologies.

[Explore user groups][27]

© Fraunhofer IPMS

### How to access APECS

 

Access APECS via open calls or collaboration to develop and scale technologies without own
infrastructure.

[Access APECS ][28]

## Explore the APECS knowledge hub

© iStock

### FAQ

 

Everything you need to know about the APECS pilot line.

 

[APECS FAQ][29]

© iStock | mattjeacock

### Latest publications

 

Learn more about our latest research outcomes and scientific contributions.

[View publications][30]

## Connect with the APECS ecosystem

### FIRST by FMD

Join the leaders shaping Europe’s semiconductor future at **FIRST by FMD**, taking place 30/09/2026
– 01/10/2026 in Berlin.

[FIRST official website][31]

### APECS Roadshow

Bringing together companies, research organizations and other key stakeholders across Europe to
discuss technological developments, industrial needs and opportunities for collaboration.

[Explore all Roadshows][32]

© Fraunhofer Mikroelektronik

### See all APECS events and webinars

Lets meet! Here is a list with all upcoming events and webinars.

[Go to events][33]

© Adobe Stock | Andreas Prott

####  [LinkedIn][34]

####  [LinkedIn-Newsletter][35]

© Ivan | Adobe Stock

### Connect with Europe's leading semiconductor experts

© FBH/Matthias Baumbach

### Access advanced packaging technologies

### Reduce development risks

### Accelerate time-to-market

### Scale innovations towards industrial deployment

© Fraunhofer IMWS


## Access APECS – Europe's gateway to advanced packaging innovation

### Annual open access call

We invite players across the semiconductor value chain to submit project ideas for selected pilot
line technologies. This year's call starts on April 1, 2026.

[Learn more][36]

### Submit your inquiry

Whether developing chiplets, sensors, or complex systems, APECS helps bringing innovations to market
efficiently and reliably.

Our experts will get back to you shortly.

[Contact us][37]

## Funding

APECS is co-funded by the Chips Joint Undertaking and national funding authorities of Austria,
Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Portugal, Spain, through the Chips for Europe Initiative.

Thanks to substantial funding from the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space
(BMFTR) and the federal states of Saxony, Berlin, Bavaria, Schleswig-Holstein, Baden-Württemberg,
North Rhine-Westphalia, Brandenburg, and Saxony-Anhalt, it will be possible to further expand the
R&D infrastructure in the coming years within the framework of the APECS pilot line.

# Pharmaceutical Medicine Manufacturers – Cefa Cilinas

We, Cefa-Cilinas Biotics Pvt. Ltd., have established a strong reputation by manufacturing an
imminent range of pharmaceutical medicines. Our company is based in Aurangabad (Maharashtra, India),
and has gained loyalty of innumerable clients by adopting effective customer-based policies. Our
years of experience and deep understanding of the field has allowed us to serve customers according
to their needs. Formulated as per laid medical industry quality guidelines, our medicinal products
are widely known across continents for their accurate compositions and high effectiveness. Our
business unit pay special attention over quality of its pharmaceutical products and adopt stringent
quality checking process so that no error go unnoticed by the eyes.

[MORE ABOUT US ][222]

#### Vision

Company always focus to develop the smart and commercially viable technology with low pollution and
execute the prompt service to the customer with excellent quality of products. Company always focus
on the offer the superior quality products at very competitive price to the customers which is most
important factor to retain the customers for long time and maintain the strong Bussiness association
with various customers.

#### Mission

Cefa-Cilinas Biotics Pvt Ltd is a leading manufacturing of chemicals, API intermediates, speciality
chemicals and Agro Ingradients. Specialised manufacturing in Iodine derivatives, acetophenone
derivatives, benzonitrile derivatives, Indole derivatives & manufacturing specialty chemicals for
bulk drugs (API), API’s and Cosmetic applications and plant growth inhibitors and plant growth
regulators.

# Pharmaceutical Medicine Manufacturers – Cefa Cilinas

We, Cefa-Cilinas Biotics Pvt. Ltd., have established a strong reputation by manufacturing an
imminent range of pharmaceutical medicines. Our company is based in Aurangabad (Maharashtra, India),
and has gained loyalty of innumerable clients by adopting effective customer-based policies. Our
years of experience and deep understanding of the field has allowed us to serve customers according
to their needs. Formulated as per laid medical industry quality guidelines, our medicinal products
are widely known across continents for their accurate compositions and high effectiveness. Our
business unit pay special attention over quality of its pharmaceutical products and adopt stringent
quality checking process so that no error go unnoticed by the eyes.

[MORE ABOUT US ][222]

#### Vision

Company always focus to develop the smart and commercially viable technology with low pollution and
execute the prompt service to the customer with excellent quality of products. Company always focus
on the offer the superior quality products at very competitive price to the customers which is most
important factor to retain the customers for long time and maintain the strong Bussiness association
with various customers.

#### Mission

Cefa-Cilinas Biotics Pvt Ltd is a leading manufacturing of chemicals, API intermediates, speciality
chemicals and Agro Ingradients. Specialised manufacturing in Iodine derivatives, acetophenone
derivatives, benzonitrile derivatives, Indole derivatives & manufacturing specialty chemicals for
bulk drugs (API), API’s and Cosmetic applications and plant growth inhibitors and plant growth
regulators.

## **CHAPPER healthcare – a leading global specialist pharmaceutical wholesaler, distributor and
## services provider**


# Welcome to CHAPPER healthcare

CHAPPER healthcare is a leading global pharmaceutical distributor and wholesaler, specialising in
importing and exporting pharmaceuticals to markets across the globe since 1975.
* Importer & exporter of unlicensed / non-registered medicines
* Rapid response to market shortages & emergency medicines
* Complete range of temperature-controlled logistical solutions
* Pharmaceutical distribution services
* Significant expertise supplying to UK healthcare market and worldwide

We are a truly global company and regularly export to more than 70 different countries. We have
longstanding relationships with clients across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and the Americas.

CHAPPER healthcare builds on its legacy of export and wholesale services, now serving as the
European market access and distribution arm of [AscellaHealth][47] to leverage our shared expertise
in supporting partners globally.


# Our core values

## Supply chain integrity and security

All procedures are GMDP (Good Manufacturing & Distribution Practice) compliant.

## Ethical way of doing business

Patient safety is paramount and central to our core values and procedures. Honesty and transparency
guide the way we act across all aspects of our business. We build relationships for the long-term.

## Service

We differentiate ourselves by our emphasis on service quality. Our team are experienced,
professional and multilingual. We are bonded by a shared goal of delivering medicines to customers
around the world in a safe and efficient way.

## Global outlook

We supply clients in over 75 countries across the globe in all inhabited continents, we are a truly
global business.

## Quality of offering

Quality applies to every aspect of our business from the quality of medicinal products we supply to
the quality of service we offer our customers.

# Search Chemo**Care.com**

Drugs, Side Effects...
Search

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

[View All][43] [Spanish][44]

### [Managing Side Effects][45]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

[View All][46] [Spanish][47]

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

[Nutritional Information][49]

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

GDP-authorized pharmaceutical wholesale distributor

## [Romanian Pharmaceutical Wholesaler for Licensed EU Partners][14]

EAST PHARMA sources, supplies, and distributes pharmaceutical products — branded, generic, and OTC —
for licensed European wholesale partners. GDP-compliant. Romania-based. Operating since 2018.

[**CONTACT US → **][15]

Who we are

## A Romanian partner for regulated pharmaceutical operations

We provide European pharmaceutical companies with direct access to the Romanian market through a
platform built on compliance, operational discipline, and commercial reliability.

Romania maintains some of the lowest regulated pharmaceutical prices in the EU, making it a
structurally relevant source market.

Authorized for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution in Romania and operating under EU GDP
standards, we support licensed partners across sourcing, supply, distribution, parallel export
coordination, and market execution. Our role is to provide a structured and dependable operating
route for pharmaceutical companies working in a regulated environment.

[**ABOUT EAST PHARMA →**][16]

[
[GDP-compliant pharmaceutical distribution and coordination in Romania]
][17]

## What we support

***01 Supply and distribution****
*GDP-compliant sourcing, supply, and distribution of branded medicines, generics, and OTC products.

***02 Commercial coordination***
Structured local support for partners requiring reliable execution, communication, and coordination
in Romania.

***03 Regulatory coordination***
Careful handling of Romanian and EU documentation requirements across distribution-related
activities.

***04 Market entry support***
Practical guidance for pharmaceutical companies entering Romania, from initial engagement to
operational follow-through.

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical wholesaler supporting licensed EU partners]
][18]

## Why pharmaceutical partners choose EAST PHARMA

***01 GDP-based operating discipline***
We work through controlled processes shaped by EU GDP requirements and regulated wholesale practice.

***02 Romanian market execution***
We support sourcing, supply, distribution, and local coordination through a clear Romanian operating
structure.

***03 Qualified B2B focus***
We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies and serious commercial partners across regulated
distribution activity.

***04 Reliable long-term cooperation***
We build long-term relationships through clear communication, workable execution, and consistent
follow-through.

[**PARTNER WITH US →**][19]

[
[Romanian pharmaceutical partner for regulated B2B operations]
][20]

## Built for professional pharmaceutical partners

We work with licensed pharmaceutical companies seeking a capable and dependable Romanian partner.
Whether the need is pharmaceutical supply, local coordination, distribution execution, or regulated
market support, we provide a structured wholesale platform, clear documentation, and dependable
operational follow-through from the outset.

[**EXPLORE SERVICES →**][21]

## Looking for a Romanian pharmaceutical partner?

Tell us what you need, and our team will respond with the most appropriate next step.

** **[** GET IN TOUCH →**][22]

Our Research       We collaborate with many outside labs, and also do research in house resulting in peer reviewed publications. For recent examples See [**Fusco et al 2025**][148], [**Shaw et al. 2023**][149], [**Gopinath et al 2022**][150], and [**Petzold et al. 2020**][151]. **Right:** Rat cerebellar molecular layer (top) and granule layer (bottom) showing microglia in green with [**RPCA-IBA-1**][152] and Purkinje cell perikarya and dendrites in red with [**CPCA-MAP2**][153]**.** Random Stuff       Many of our images are available for free use on [**Wikimedia Commons**][154] see [**EnCor images here**][155]. Also see our Youtube movie of [**HeLa Cells**][156] showing staining with our antibodies to actin, β-tubulin, fibrillarin and HSP60 along with a nuclear DNA stain. When cells become activated by growth factors, neurotransmitters, damage or stress a common response is to rapidly and transiently activate the expression of several genes, the best known being c-FOS, The c-FOS protein is a transcriptional regulator which activates the expression of many other genes. Following stimulation levels of c-FOS rapidly increase and then rapidly decline, so that cells expressing large amounts of c-FOS are in the process of activating downstream gene expression. While all three work well on western blots and IHC, the MCA-1B62 and RPCA-c-FOS reagents are more sensitive than MCA-2H2 on floating sections. # Mouse Monoclonal Antibody to c-FOS (cFos, Fos, AP-1), Cat# MCA-1B62 $250.00 / Amount: 100µL of 1mg/mL 100µL of 1mg/mL 500µL of 1mg/mL Product variants 100µL of 1mg/mL - $250.00 500µL of 1mg/mL - $1,000.00 Quantity Add to cart [View product details ][167] ### Featured products- Antibodies to FOX3/NeuN      Many years ago [**Mullen et al. 1992**][168] described a mouse monoclonal antibody, named A60, which stained the vast majority of neurons, mostly in the nucleus but spreading to the proximal cytoplasm in certain cells. They named the protein to which the antibody bound "[**NeuN**][169]" for neuronal nuclei. The antibody became widely used even though the identity of the NeuN protein was unknown for many years. Finally [**KIm et al. 2009**][170]** ** showed that NeuN was actually [**FOX3**][171], a neuron specific RNA binding protein. We made a panel of high quality FOX3/NeuN antibodies in mouse, rabbit, chicken and goat. Our antibodies are epitope mapped and we document that our monoclonal antibody [**MCA-1B7**][172] binds FOX3/NeuN with greater affinity and has a higher titre than A60. The antibody is widely used see [**Google Scholar search**][173]** **and is also considerably cheaper than other alternatives. * 12
  CiteScore
  CiteScore measures the average citations received per peer-reviewed document. CiteScore values are
  based on citation counts in a range of four years to peer-reviewed documents published in the same
  four calendar years, divided by the number of these documents in these same four years.
  2025 CiteScore © 2026 Elsevier B.V.

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

[ESMO Guidelines Opens in new window][80]

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

[Damian Seeto]

Damian Seeto

Gaming Contributor

Damian has been contributing for Techday since 2009 and is always available whenever a video game
needs to be reviewed. Aside from being a big gamer, he is also one of biggest professional wrestling
fans. Damian likes Star Wars, comic book movies and Metallica.

## Our Editorial Team

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

[Damian Seeto]

Damian Seeto

Gaming Contributor

Damian has been contributing for Techday since 2009 and is always available whenever a video game
needs to be reviewed. Aside from being a big gamer, he is also one of biggest professional wrestling
fans. Damian likes Star Wars, comic book movies and Metallica.

# Lebsa – API Manufacturing Company & Supplier

Origin matters. **It’s not only what we do**, but also how **we do it** and who’s behind every
process. In a world of generics, **LEBSA is a unique strategic partner**
as API manufacturing Supplier.

[See more About us][46]

## Our Solutions

### Niche and tailor made API’s

Agile, scalable production, from available products to specific requests with total quality control
and regulatory management.

[PRODUCTS][47]

### Customer focused

Responsive service for the increasingly demanding health industry. We don’t just make API’s, we make
business happen.

[ABOUT US][48]

### Strategic R&D approach

The API industry is quickly becoming more competitive, demanding and complex. We invest in R&D
strategies and new processes.

[VIEW R&D][49]

## Our Brandmark

### Facilities

Everything is done within our own facilities, giving us complete control over operations and
production management.

[View more about facilities][50]

### Regulatory

We provide the **API regulatory support** you need to get your products to market on time in a
complex, interconnected world.

[View more about regulatory][51]

### Quality

LEBSA’s rigorous **API quality assurance** systems provide total peace of mind for our partners in
the **pharma industry.**

[View more about quality][52]

### Environment & Safety

The **respect for the environment** of LEBSA, ensures the correct treatment of solid and liquid
waste management.

[View about environment & safety][53]

BusKill is a USB kill cord for your laptop. It is designed to protect your data if your device is

customisable security response: from locking your screen to shutting down or securely erasing

## Discover Heads firmware

Combine the power of Qubes OS compartmentalisation, Heads boot integrity verification and physical
anti-tamper measures such as security tape, serialised seals, and photographs of the anti-tamper
options via Proton Mail.

Ideal for journalists, researchers, activists, or anyone who demands the highest level of security.

[SecurityTitan laptops][87]
[Upgrade to Heads][88]

## BusKill: a USB kill cord

BusKill is a USB kill cord for your laptop. It is designed to protect your data if your device is
suddenly taken from you.

When the magnetic USB cable is disconnected (e.g., due to snatch-and-run theft), it triggers a
customisable security response: from locking your screen to shutting down or securely erasing
encryption keys.

*[Watch the video on YouTube][89].*

## About
## Aark Pharmaceutical

Aark Pharmaceuticals, a Global Pharmaceutical Supplier & Distributor stands as a reputable
pharmaceutical sourcing entity with a firm dedication to supplying premium generic medicines sourced
from India to a global clientele. Our core ethos revolves around delivering excellence through
highest quality generic medications, guaranteeing both quality and cost-effectiveness.

We are proud to serve a wide array of clients, encompassing NGOs, hospitals, resellers, pharmacies,
and pharmaceutical firms. Focusing solely on generic medicine procurement, our services are tailored
to prioritize unmatched quality and affordability, addressing the diverse healthcare requirements of
our esteemed global customers.

There are 500 API manufacturers contributing about 8% in the global API Industry. India is the
largest supplier of generic medicines. It manufactures about 60,000 different generic brands across
60 therapeutic categories and accounts for 20% of the global supply of generics.

The country plays a significant role in the global pharmaceutical industry, providing a wide range
of affordable and high-quality generic medications to various countries worldwide. The Indian
pharmaceutical sector has gained recognition for its ability to produce cost-effective generic drugs
while maintaining compliance with international quality standards. Many pharmaceutical companies in
India actively contribute to meeting the global demand for generic medicines.

Aark Pharmaceuticals is the largest supplier of low cost generic patented drugs. It has wide range
of pharma product rance, about 28,000 different generic brands across 40 plus therapeutic
categories.

Major segments of Aark Pharmaceuticals include low cost generic patented drugs, OTC medicines, bulk
drugs, vaccines, contract research & manufacturing, biosimilars and biologics. Aark Pharmaceuticals
is one of the biggest supplier of DPT, BCG, and Measles vaccines.’

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

# from product discovery to closed deal

making the deals happen.

sources.

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory
agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory
agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily.
How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide
insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification.
Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI
research, data export, and priority support.
How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

PRODUCTS
Cardiovascular
The VesSpiral® Coronary Dilatation Balloon Catheters are indicated for: Balloon dilatation of the
stenotic portion of a coronary artery or bypass graft stenosis in patients evidencing coronary
ischemia for the purpose of improving myocardial perfusion Balloon dilatation of a coronary artery
occlusion for the treatment of acute myocardial infarction.
[ READ MORE ][86]
Peripheral
Perwalker® PTA Balloon Catheter is a high performance balloon catheter for peripheral indication.
-Non-compliant and Non-compliant Balloon Catheter
-Precision Expansion
-High Pressure& Rupture-Resistant
-Excellent Crossability
-Rapid Exchange design with Transmooth Technology
-Comprehensive size options for various vessel segments
[ READ MORE ][87]
Pulmonary Intervention
MultiStage® Balloon Dilator is intended to be used to endoscopically dilate strictures located in
the esophagus, pylorus, duodenum, colon and the airway tree, also available for use in ERCP biliary
stone extraction and Dilatation Assisted Stone Extraction (DASE) procedures.
[ READ MORE ][88]
Neurovascular
-Excellent Crossability: Taper-Tip Design for Easy Penetration
-Great Trace/Travelability: Low balloon profile, clearer marker band, easy traveling & tracing
inside
-Precision Expansion: Precision controlled balloon compliance and length expansion
-Maximum pushability/Deliverability: TranSmooth™ design makes it maximum pushable in most torque
vessel.
-Excellent Crossability: Minimum intro-profile make it easy for using in small vessel.
[ READ MORE ][89]
Digest Tract
MultiStage® Balloon Dilator is intended to be used to endoscopically dilate strictures located in
the esophagus, pylorus, duodenum, colon and the airway tree, also available for use in ERCP biliary
stone extraction and Dilatation Assisted Stone Extraction (DASE) procedures.
[ READ MORE ][90]

PRODUCTS
Cardiovascular
The VesSpiral® Coronary Dilatation Balloon Catheters are indicated for: Balloon dilatation of the
stenotic portion of a coronary artery or bypass graft stenosis in patients evidencing coronary
ischemia for the purpose of improving myocardial perfusion Balloon dilatation of a coronary artery
occlusion for the treatment of acute myocardial infarction.
[ READ MORE ][86]
Peripheral
Perwalker® PTA Balloon Catheter is a high performance balloon catheter for peripheral indication.
-Non-compliant and Non-compliant Balloon Catheter
-Precision Expansion
-High Pressure& Rupture-Resistant
-Excellent Crossability
-Rapid Exchange design with Transmooth Technology
-Comprehensive size options for various vessel segments
[ READ MORE ][87]
Pulmonary Intervention
MultiStage® Balloon Dilator is intended to be used to endoscopically dilate strictures located in
the esophagus, pylorus, duodenum, colon and the airway tree, also available for use in ERCP biliary
stone extraction and Dilatation Assisted Stone Extraction (DASE) procedures.
[ READ MORE ][88]
Neurovascular
-Excellent Crossability: Taper-Tip Design for Easy Penetration
-Great Trace/Travelability: Low balloon profile, clearer marker band, easy traveling & tracing
inside
-Precision Expansion: Precision controlled balloon compliance and length expansion
-Maximum pushability/Deliverability: TranSmooth™ design makes it maximum pushable in most torque
vessel.
-Excellent Crossability: Minimum intro-profile make it easy for using in small vessel.
[ READ MORE ][89]
Digest Tract
MultiStage® Balloon Dilator is intended to be used to endoscopically dilate strictures located in
the esophagus, pylorus, duodenum, colon and the airway tree, also available for use in ERCP biliary
stone extraction and Dilatation Assisted Stone Extraction (DASE) procedures.
[ READ MORE ][90]
